verdict.rationale: Fern's changelog explicitly references a 'self-hosted container' that resolves environment variables per request, confirming a self-hosting deployment option exists, and community commentary notes Fern is open-source (though not free). However, there is no first-party documentation on how to actually deploy/run the self-hosted container, no setup guide, and no independent hands-on report confirming feasibility. Missing for 10: dedicated self-hosting setup docs, license/repo confirmation of what's open-sourced vs. hosted-only, and independent verification of a working self-hosted deployment.
